data.summary: Praxis für Osteopathie Beispielgelenk billed Johanna Beispielacker €255.00 for three osteopathic treatments in October and November 2026. Payment is due within 21 days of the invoice date (18 November 2026).
data.explanation: This is a private invoice (Privatrechnung) from an osteopathy practice for three treatment sessions. You need to pay €255.00 to the practice's bank account by the deadline shown by the app (21 days from the invoice date). The letter notes this is VAT-exempt and advises checking with your supplemental health insurance (Zusatzversicherung) separately about any reimbursement. If you don't pay in time, the practice may send a reminder; there is no stated court or statutory consequence beyond normal late-payment rules. Keep the invoice for a possible insurance refund claim and for your tax records, as medical costs can sometimes be claimed as extraordinary expenses (außergewöhnliche Belastungen).
data.tax_note: Medical treatment costs not reimbursed by insurance can potentially be claimed as extraordinary expenses (außergewöhnliche Belastungen) in the tax return; keep this invoice and any insurer reimbursement statement.
